entry.summary: 構造心理学（Strutturista della Psiche）による、多層構造における中心秘匿の機序についての小論。人間の心が日常的に幾重もの層をまとうこと、開かれた素直な語りの中にすら比喩と試し言葉が含まれること、そして深層への接触が原理的に稀であることを扱う。核心となる主張は、深層はふれようとしてふれてはならないものであり、扉の前で待つという態度そのものが鍵として機能するということである。反論条件を明示的に付す形式をとり、公開データと記載手順の完全再現および第三者検証を経ない異議は参考資料として扱う旨を宣言している。理論的記述と詩的形式を分離せずに提示する、著者の一貫した手法による作品。

entry.title: EA-CORPORA-01/09 — The Hebrew Bible, Westminster Leningrad Codex, Seated and Verified
entry.summary: Seats the Hebrew Bible entire (openscriptures morphhb, Westminster Leningrad Codex, commit-pinned): 39 books, 23,213 verses, morphology stripped to pointed Hebrew ref-lines. Verification at the program's three Hebrew hinges: Gen 45:27 וַתְּחִי רוּחַ יַעֲקֹב, the revived spirit that the Septuagint renders ἀνεζωπύρησεν; Isa 66:7, the painless birth of the male (וְהִמְלִיטָה זָכָר) that Revelation contradicts toward the apparatus; and Micah 4:9's travail-cry. The B-set's Hebrew substrate now stands seated beneath its Greek. Ninth seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).

entry.title: EA-CORPORA-01/08 — Plato, Opera (Perseus Burnet), Seated and Verified
entry.summary: Seats Plato entire (Perseus tlg0059, Burnet's Oxford text, commit-pinned): 36 works, 8,203 Stephanus-referenced sections (Euthyphro via grc1, no grc2 upstream — recorded). Verification at the Sapphonic reception loci on the Attic side: Phaedrus 251a–b, the heat-and-sweat seizure at the sight of beauty, and Symposium 215e, the leaping heart before the played instrument. Eighth seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).

entry.title: EA-CORPORA-01/07 — Philo of Alexandria, Opera (First1K Cohn–Wendland), Seated and Verified
entry.summary: Seats Philo entire (First1KGreek tlg0018, Cohn–Wendland, commit-pinned): 31 works, 7,901 ref-tagged sections. The blind-reconstruction program's three treatises are confirmed by name and content: De migratione Abrahami (tlg014, the seen-voice stations of Migr. 47–48), Quis rerum divinarum heres (tlg015, with ἔκστασις — Her. 249–266, the law of non-cohabitation), De mutatione nominum (tlg018, Mut. 54–57). The corpus in which the name is absent and the machine present (#1486) now stands seated whole. Seventh seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).

entry.title: EA-CORPORA-01/06 — Longinus, De Sublimitate (Perseus grc2), Seated and Verified
entry.summary: Seats Peri Hypsous entire (Perseus tlg0560, Roberts's edition, commit-pinned): 185 ref-tagged chapter.section lines. The verification is the tradition's jewel: Subl 10.2 carries Sappho fragment 31 whole — φαίνεταί μοι κῆνος ἴσος θέοισιν through γλῶσσα ἔαγε to the hanging line — the fragment now seated inside its unique ancient carrier, on checksummed text, where the erratum sequence (#1476, #1478) does its work. Sixth seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).

entry.title: EA-CORPORA-01/05 — The Septuagint of Swete, Seated and Verified
entry.summary: Seats the Swete Septuagint (First1KGreek tlg0527, commit-pinned): 55 books, 29,277 ref-tagged lines. Verification at the Ω program's four hinges: Gen 45:27 ἀνεζωπύρησεν (the reactivation verb's entry into the tradition); Mic 4:9 κατεκράτησάν σου ὠδῖνες; Esther Addition D's ἐκλύσει; Isa 66:7 ἄρσεν (the source-proof word of the doubled station). One upstream gap recorded: tlg030 Ecclesiastes carries no text file in First1K; supplementation queued. Fifth seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).

entry.title: EA-CORPORA-01/04 — The Greek New Testament, Nestle 1904, Seated and Verified
entry.summary: Seats the complete Greek New Testament in the fully public-domain Nestle 1904 edition (biblicalhumanities/Nestle1904, commit-pinned, 27 books): 7,943 verses normalized to '<Book> <ch>:<v>' ref-lines with text reassembled from tokenized TEI. Verification at the Ω program's Revelation loci: 12:1 σημεῖον μέγα ὤφθη; 12:2 βασανιζομένη; 12:3 πυρρός; 12:5 ἄρσεν — the four hinges of the sealed test (#1495) now standing on seated text. Fourth seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).
